石溪村！

盛夏，大日头跟个火球一样挂在天上，蝉鸣响透了整个屯子，寡妇和汉子在草垛子里胡作非为，大黄狗耷拉着舌头。

田间地头庄稼耷拉着脑袋，叶片都被弄的卷边了。

低矮破败的陈旧土屋中，光线昏暗，空气中散发着干燥和泥土的味道。

“青山，喝醉了吧，婶子扶你去房间里休息！”

赵贵老两口相互对视一眼，闪过一抹狡黠，搀着醉醺醺，满身酒气的李青山，便朝着自家儿媳的房间走了过去。

老子，重生了？

脑海中的醉意去了个七七八八，望着眼前熟悉的场景，记忆迅速回溯。

这一日。

赵贵老两口谋划自家宅基地和房子，将自己这个有名的二流子灌醉后，扒了衣裳，扔到儿媳王乃香的床上。

然后贼喊捉贼，非说自己强奸了他儿媳，除非把家里新建的那套房子赔给他们，否则就报警，这至少也是个强奸未遂。

毕竟，李青山在村子里名声本来也不好！

好在王乃香及时解释，免了牢狱之灾。

但二人的名声却是臭了。

而且王乃香打乱了公婆的计划，在家中日日挨打受虐，别人也不好插手去管。

一个月后。

王乃香受不得村里人的风言风语和婆家虐待，跳河自杀了。

赵贵一家子却认为是自己害死了她儿媳妇，日日上门来闹，加上自己名声坏了，想要在本地讨媳妇几乎不可能，只得背井离乡去讨生活。

因祸得福，拜了一位老道士为师，得了道医传承，也学了些打猎之类的其他手段，更是得过第一炮头的称号。

这一世重来，定要让这赵贵两口子付出代价！

“行了，赶紧出去喊人，老李家那套新房子总算是到手了，够还咱儿子的赌债了。”

赵贵两口子将李青山丢到床上后，便匆匆出去喊人了。

儿子，赌债？

躺在床上的李青山再次回忆起来。

这老两口所说的应当是他们的小儿子，长子在结婚那天，被炮给炸死了！

说起来。

王乃香这小寡妇还是个雏！

赵贵的长子也是倒霉，结婚时，自己做了个大炮仗，炸的时候旁边刚好有根铁钉，一下刺到胸口，就此没了，王乃香也守了三年寡。

赵贵家的债主，则是村里的一霸，李虎！

那一日，王乃香帮自己证明了清白，赵贵小儿子的赌债可就还不上了，李虎便要王乃香当他媳妇，只要王乃香愿意，什么债务一笔勾销。

王乃香自是不愿。

每天晚上，都能听见赵家传来公婆打骂王乃香的声音。

这也是王乃香承受不住，跳河自杀的主要原因。

跳河前一日。

王乃香寻到了自己，向自己吐露心声，想要自己带她离开这里私奔，懦弱的自己并不敢同意。

Stony Brook Village!

In midsummer, the sun hangs in the sky like a fireball, the chirping of cicadas fills the entire village, the widow and the man are misbehaving in the haystacks, and the big yellow dog hangs out its tongue.

The crops in the fields were drooping, and their leaves were curled.

The light in the low, dilapidated old mud house is dim, and the air smells of dryness and earth.

"Qingshan, you must be drunk. Auntie will help you go to the room to rest!"

Mr. and Mrs. Zhao Gui looked at each other, flashed a hint of cunning, and walked towards their daughter-in-law's room with Li Qingshan, who was drunk and smelling of alcohol.

I am reborn?

The drunkenness in my mind has gone away, and I look at the familiar scene in front of me, and my memory quickly goes back.

This day.

Zhao Gui and his wife planned their own homestead and house. After getting themselves, a famous second-rate man, drunk, they took off his clothes and threw them on the bed of their daughter-in-law Wang Naixiang.

Then the thief shouted to catch the thief, and unless he said that he had raped his daughter-in-law, and unless he compensated them for the newly built house at home, he would call the police. This was at least an attempted rape.

After all, Li Qingshan’s reputation in the village was not good to begin with!

Fortunately, Wang Naixiang explained in time and avoided jail.

But their reputations are ruined.

Moreover, Wang Naixiang disrupted the plans of her parents-in-law and was beaten and abused every day at home, making it difficult for others to intervene.

One month later.

Wang Naixiang couldn't bear the gossip from the villagers and the abuse from her husband's family, so she committed suicide by jumping into the river.

However, Zhao Gui's family believed that they had killed their daughter-in-law, and they came to make trouble every day. In addition, because of their bad reputation, it was almost impossible to find a wife locally, so they had to leave their hometown to make a living.

As a blessing in disguise, he became a disciple of an old Taoist priest, received the inheritance of Taoist medicine, learned some other methods such as hunting, and even earned the title of No. 1 Cannon.

In this life, Zhao and Gui will definitely be made to pay the price!

"Okay, hurry up and call someone. We finally got the new house from Lao Li's house. It's enough to pay off our son's gambling debt."

After Zhao Gui and his wife threw Li Qingshan on the bed, they hurried out to call for someone.

Son, gambling debt?

Li Qingshan, who was lying on the bed, recalled it again.

The old couple should be talking about their youngest son. The eldest son was killed by a cannon on their wedding day!

Talk about it.

The little widow Wang Naixiang is still a baby!

Zhao Gui's eldest son was also unlucky. When he got married, he made a big firecracker. When it exploded, there happened to be an iron nail next to it. It pierced his chest and disappeared. Wang Naixiang also remained a widow for three years.

The creditor of the Zhao Gui family is the village tyrant, Li Hu!

On that day, Wang Naixiang helped him prove his innocence, and Zhao Gui's younger son's gambling debt could not be repaid. Li Hu asked Wang Naixiang to be his wife. As long as Wang Naixiang was willing, all debts could be written off.

Wang Naixiang naturally didn't want to.

Every night, one could hear the sound of the parents-in-law beating and scolding Wang Naixiang from the Zhao family.

This is also the main reason why Wang Naixiang couldn't bear it anymore and committed suicide by jumping into the river.

The day before jumping into the river.

Wang Naixiang found herself and confided in herself that she wanted to take her away from here and elope, but her cowardly self did not dare to agree.
